§6Machine type: §aMulti Lightning Rod§r

"Thunder is God's cannon."
"But now we will control the thunder."
Maximum storage capacity of 512 lightning rods(I).
Each lightning rod produces 28 MEU per lightning strike and stores 280 MEU.
Ignoring thunderstorm weather for power generation.
Consume 128mb cruotheum and 72mb*the number of lightning rods of molten iron ever lightning
Quantitative input is required, too much or too little can lead to power generation failure
Before dismantling the machine, please output the lightning rod first!
Otherwise all internal lightning rods will be lost!
Use a wire cutter to enable/disable lightning animation.

[note]Hatches[/note]: Input Bus, Input Hatch, Output Bus, Dynamo Hatch
Use a Hologram Projector (or the NEI structure preview) to see and auto-build the structure.

[note]Controller recipe[/note]: Assembler, IV
 - GTPP Casing IV
 - 4x Energy Core EV
 - 2x Emitter IV
 - 2x Sensor IV
 - 4x Field Generator HV
 - 2,304 L Molten Rubber Silicone
